analogy.rationale: WNT/CTNNB1 signaling is largely inactive in these cell lines and CTNNB1 is rarely a direct drug target, so WNT inhibitors should produce little transcriptional response; gamma-secretase, GLI, and smoothened inhibitors act in related developmental pathways and may show modest overlap, while GSK3 and TGF-beta inhibitors intersect WNT crosstalk weakly.
